note: people_id to VoteApp candidate id for the Oklahoma 60th Legislature (LegiScan session 2219, which holds both the 2025 and 2026 regular sessions). Seats come from LegiScan's `district` field, never from `role`: four sitting senators are filed as `Rep` (Shane Jett SD-017, Casey Murdock SD-027, Avery Frix SD-009, Regina Goodwin SD-011). 53 of 154 members map to a candidate: 51 proposed and accepted, 2 hand-added. Every unmatched member was checked by surname and by seat against every unmatched candidate, and only those two were real misses. The nulls split into members whose seat has no candidate row in our November 2026 roster and members whose seat is on the ballot but who are not seeking it.
